description: NHFLOW semi-implicit step with wall friction at every wall face (A 519 2): the 3D channel with side walls of nhflow_3d_channel_walls_kepsilon_mpi2 (30 x 6 x 1.5 m, 9 m3/s, k-epsilon, ks 1 cm, 2 ranks split in y) with A 510 11. The log-law drag of the side walls on u and w (and of the bed on u and v) implicit on the diagonal of the column operators of the cells and of the layer faces; the column of VH with its own walls.
